about_the_game:
A dinner invitation turns into a deadly game of wits… and this demo lets you experience the first complete challenge.

You arrive at a mysterious manor for an elegant meal — but as the doors lock behind you, guests turn to statues, whispers crawl through the walls, and the host’s intentions grow darker with each passing moment.

In this demo, you will explore:

  • 1 complete room area made up of multiple interconnected rooms and puzzles.

  • 6 story-driven chapters — a mix of puzzle stages and cinematic sequences — that form this first area.

  • Steam Achievements for progress and challenges in these initial levels.

  • Steam Cloud support to save your demo progress across devices.

  • A sample of the atmospheric storytelling, evolving environments, and interconnected clues from the full game.

Key Features in the Demo:
🧩 Cinematic Escape-Room Puzzles – Handcrafted challenges that weave into the mystery, from cryptic logic riddles to mechanical devices, within the first complete room area.
🎬 Movie-Style Storytelling – Integrated cinematics introduce the characters, setting, and the opening threads of the mystery.
🔍 Interconnected Clues – Every puzzle solved brings you closer to understanding the truth behind the dinner.
🌗 Evolving Atmosphere – Shift from warm intrigue to shadow-drenched tension as you progress through the first area.
🎧 Immersive Audio & Feedback – Custom voice acting (English), layered ambient soundscapes, and visual cues reward every breakthrough.
☁ Steam Cloud – Continue your demo progress on any supported device.

In the full game you’ll find:

  • 6 complete room areas with unique puzzle designs and multiple rooms each.

  • 15 story-driven chapters with cinematic sequences before, between, and after puzzle areas.

  • Additional puzzles, achievements, and story moments that expand the mystery.

    Will you uncover the truth before the final course is served… or become part of the manor’s collection?

content_descriptors.notes: There is no physical violence but a psychological horror story, full of mystery.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Window 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6500 or AMD Ryzen 5 1400
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 970 or AMD RX 570 (4 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Realtek HD Audio
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-8700K CPU @ 3.70GHz 3.70 GHz
  • Memory: 32 MB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1080 TI
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 12 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Realtek HD Audio
